## Practical distinction

Setup10m, observation1m. OneUP/bar2 differs from lasttwoUP/bar3. Firstminute-close belowtruecurrentopen selects a causal signal; futurecurrentbarcolor neverselects it. Distances use future-only lows5/10/20min after signal; mean favorable excursion differs from endpoint continuation. Gap-safe primary minute1–9 ten-minute follow-up: oneUP9/26lower, meanfall$2.76/0.288%, max$9.33/0.969%; twoUP16/22lower, mean$5.14/0.532%, max$17.57/1.789%. Gap-safe existingbanner>=5min proxy: oneUP7/17lower, mean$3.14/0.326%, max$12.32/1.278%; twoUP12/20lower, mean$4.70/0.488%, max$20.36/2.100%. Do not substitute early-trigger rates for currentbanner timing. The sample maximum is no future bound; price can recover despite a favorable low. Old19/24nextcandlecolor is a different question.
